name: Word Counter
summary: Count words, sentences, paragraphs, and estimate reading time — all locally.
description: Paste any text to see live word, sentence, paragraph, and line counts plus a rough reading-time estimate. Nothing leaves your browser.

faqs.question: How are words counted?
faqs.answer: Words are whitespace-separated tokens. Multiple spaces and newlines collapse into a single separator.

faqs.question: How is reading time estimated?
faqs.answer: We assume about 200 words per minute and round up to at least one minute when there is any text.

faqs.question: Is my draft uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Counting runs entirely in your browser.
